global_rules.rule: If this SOP conflicts with applicable law, regulation, contractual obligation, or company policy, the stricter requirement governs.
All steps in this SOP must be performed using only the following tools.
Do not reference or rely on any software, service, or data source other than those listed below unless this document is formally amended.

Source data (reports, exports, clearing confirmations, policy PDFs, claim packets, etc.) is assumed to arrive as attachments on the Jira issues or Email threads cited in each procedure, or as files you save to Excel/Word from those attachments.
If an expected attachment is missing, follow the exception path (typically Jira escalation) for that section.
If you lack access to any required tool, create a Jira ticket in the IT-Support queue immediately.
If a required field is blank or missing on a particular issue, follow the fallback path noted for that field.

Reporting Manager | Custom field on HR, T&E, and expense issues containing the Jira username of the employee's direct manager. Fallback: Email people@vanguardshield.com with the employee's full name. If no result, create a Jira ticket in HR-Ops queue using Template B-8 (§Appendix B).

Department Head | Custom field on OPS-FIN-BVA-* issues containing the budget owner's name. Fallback: search the BVA issue description for "Budget Owner"; if not present, Email finance.ops@vanguardshield.com citing the BVA issue key.
Billing Contact Email | Field in the issue description on OPS-AR-CLIENT-* issues. If blank, Slack ar-collections using Template B-5.
Rate Table Source | Field in OPS-UW-POL-* issue description referencing the canonical rate- table Jira issue key and file name.

Queue Assignee | Role-based routing: read the pinned issue "Queue Roles & Assignees" on the target queue board. If missing or blank, create a Jira IT-Support ticket titled "Missing Queue Assignee – [Queue Name] – [Role]" and Slack ops- support.
Materiality Override | If a queue's pinned issue includes a "Materiality Override" section with a different dollar threshold, that Jira-posted threshold governs over this SOP's printed threshold.

Underwriting intake (UW data requests): Email underwriting.ops@vanguardshield.com when a procedure requires payroll or underwriting application data by email after Jira comment and @mention paths are exhausted (see §5.2).

OPS-HR-TE workflow (Sales T&E): Use the Approve, Reject, and related transition names documented on the HR-Expense or OPS-HR-TE queue board pinned issue "Workflow & Transitions" (Jira is the system of record; labels may differ by scheme).
UW data Slack (optional notice, keys only): Use uw-data-requests unless the underwriting queue pinned issue names a different channel.
All output files produced under this SOP must follow the naming pattern stated in the procedure that creates them.
Where a procedure does not specify a file name, use the default convention: [Deliverable Type] [Identifier] [Date YYYY-MM-DD].[ext]
Do not use spaces in file names; use underscores.
All external emails must be sent from an authorized @vanguardshield.com account.
The following codes are used in Jira labels, comments, or workflow transitions.

policy_questions.question: The SOP names Jira projects and issues such as FIN-Exceptions, TRE-Investments and OPS-FIN-SUSPENSE-[YYYY-MM]. The tool accepts project_key only as capitals, digits and underscores, and issue_key only as KEY-number. Which Jira project and issue does each SOP name mean, and where is that mapping written?

The SOP tells the analyst to attach files to Jira issues, and no tool in the tool list attaches a file to a Jira issue. What counts as attaching (a comment naming the file, a saved file, or something else)?

All steps must use only Email, Calendar, Slack, Shopify, Jira, Excel, Word, PowerPoint and PDF. The agent has no Excel, Word or PowerPoint tool, only a sandbox with files, Python and Bash. May the sandbox stand in for them, and in what file formats must the deliverables be?

The Audited Premium custom field must be populated, and the Jira tools reject custom fields (update_issue takes summary, description, priority, assignee and labels). Is the comment enough, or how must this field be set?
§2.3 filters Transaction Amount for values ≥ $10,000, and the capitalization step speaks of items > $10,000. Is an item of exactly $10,000 in scope of the capitalization step?

Appendix C says the codes are used in Jira labels, comments, or workflow transitions, and steps say "set status", "label or comment" or "per team convention". For each code, must it be a label, a comment or a transition, or does any one of them count?
The SOP uses business days, weekends and holidays, and it gives no calendar. Which holiday calendar decides a business day and a holiday for these steps?

§4.1 tells the analyst to comment account status Collections Hold when the letter is sent. Template D-3 tells the client the account may be placed on Collections Hold if no response comes within the timeframe. When does the hold start?

§3.4 requires a W-9 PDF that is attached and current, and the hold applies when no W-9 PDF is on the record. Does a W-9 that is attached and not current also get the hold, and what makes a W-9 current?
The Decision matrix triggers on a date inconsistency that undermines loss timing. Does every inconsistency noted in the Metadata sanity check undermine loss timing, and if not, which ones do?
§6.2 sets the expense report workflow to rejected when one line fails, and Template B-2 says the line item was rejected. Does one failed line reject the whole report?
Template B-8 is for the Jira HR-Ops description and/or an Email to hrops@vanguardshield.com, and §1.3 and §6.2 name only the Jira ticket. Is the Email to hrops required, optional or a substitute?

The default file name is printed with no separators between [Deliverable Type], [Identifier] and [Date YYYY-MM-DD], and no spaces are allowed. Is the name [Deliverable Type]_[Identifier]_[Date YYYY-MM-DD].[ext], as the underscores in the examples suggest?
TransferAmount may round to the nearest $1,000, so a rounded amount can leave the balance under $15,000,000. Should the amount round up in that case?
